competitors.B0: preserved parent forecast, exact model version
competitors.B1: Dunks and Threes external forecast, exact documented generation
competitors.C2: C1 fit on C2-complete events + gamma dot standardized factors

objective: mean squared error + alpha_ridge*alpha^2 + weight_ridge*w^2; C2 residual MSE + factor_ridge*sum(gamma^2)
standardization: training-event mean and population SD; zero variance scale=1; no imputation
minimum_note: Operational pilot floor only; not a power calculation or qualification threshold. Fixed before fitting. Any change requires a successor protocol.
hyperparameter_policy: Fixed penalties, no tuning in this pilot. A tuned successor needs nested chronological selection.
history_policy: One baseline version, one external model generation and live record type per fit. Unknown versions, reconstructed history and source captures after cutoff are excluded. No pooled-vintage fit.
availability_policy: Keep every opportunity; report complete-source matched events and B0 fallback separately. Never relabel B0 fallback as challenger.

evaluation_policy.primary: paired absolute margin error on identical eligible events
evaluation_policy.confirmation: Future writer-registered cohort only; no confirmation cohort registered by this implementation
evaluation_policy.uncertainty: date-block paired intervals required before any improvement claim; not executed with current ineligible data
evaluation_policy.probabilities: separately fit from chronological OOS challenger residuals; NOT_IMPLEMENTED in this mean-only pilot
evaluation_policy.economic_evaluation: separate frozen-price audit; not part of fitting or confidence
evaluation_policy.oos_schedule: expanding prior events; train labels available strictly before each target feature cutoff; no same-event training reuse
